rationale: Google has committed to 30 GWh of Form Energy's iron-air long-duration storage capacity for its AI-datacenter power needs; this $750M Series G directly funds the buildout Google is depending on to secure grid capacity for AI compute load.

Grid-scale long-duration storage deployments require power management and electrical distribution equipment; Eaton is a leading supplier to utility-scale storage buildouts that stand to grow as Form Energy scales with fresh capital.

Quanta is a leading grid interconnection and utility EPC contractor positioned to capture construction/interconnection work as Form Energy's Series G funds deployment of new iron-air storage sites tied to AI-datacenter and utility load growth.
